title: Ride Rite
summary: Full-stack e-commerce app with Strapi CMS and Stripe payments.
description: Ride Rite simulates an online bicycle shop. Visitors browse the product catalogue, add items to the cart, and pay through Stripe. Formik and Yup validate the user input.
posterAlt: Ride Rite home page with a large Summer Sale banner over a photo of a cyclist in a city street.

title: Nomad Hive
summary: Marketplace that connects travellers with short-term homestays and experiences worldwide.
description: Nomad Hive is an online marketplace that connects travellers with short-term homestays and experiences worldwide. It serves both travellers and hosts. React, Next.js, Prisma, and MongoDB keep the platform fast, secure, and scalable.
posterAlt: Nomad Hive listing grid with a search bar, category icons, and holiday home cards with prices per night.

title: SweetApp
summary: Full-stack site with an interactive map, authentication, user accounts, and dessert listings with ratings and reviews.
description: SweetApp is a full-stack website where users create, edit, rate, and review dessert listings. It has an interactive map, authentication, and user accounts. It uses EJS, the Mapbox API, Cloudinary, Helmet, Sanitize-HTML, and Joi for validation.
posterAlt: SweetApp browse page: a map of the United States with dessert location markers above a grid of dessert cards with photos.

title: Block Breaker
summary: Game built from scratch: 10 levels, 11 bonus types, 7 game modes, and touch controls.
description: Block Breaker is a game built from scratch with vanilla JavaScript and CSS. It has 10 levels, 11 bonus types, 7 game modes, and control buttons for touchscreen devices. It was my first project.
posterAlt: Block Breaker game in play: a white ball between rows of glossy coloured blocks, a black pad, and a score panel.

title: Solar System
summary: A solar system animated with CSS only, with no JavaScript.
description: An animation of the solar system that uses CSS only. It has no JavaScript. It was my first project with Sass.
posterAlt: Pure CSS solar system: a glowing orange sun with planets, Saturn's rings, and moons in orbit on a starfield.
